versions.changelog:
Initial release of frontend-spec.

- Provides comprehensive enterprise-level frontend development standards covering naming, directory structure, CSS/JS/TS, Vue/React, Git, build, performance, and security.
- Includes detailed conventions for project organization, code style, best practices, and git commit messages.
- Supports both web and mobile projects with practical, team-aligned guidelines.
- Enables users to ask about specific rules and best practices for fast reference.
